metadata.description: Cohere embeddings (A/A+) merged with E5 Channel C results

paths.description: Seeing the artificial nature of carefully planned footage, like looking in a mirror and seeing a stranger, then finding authentic story in unplanned moments
paths.reasoning: Clear M9 path: reflection (seeing self in work) + crisis (realizing artificiality) → shatter ('everything shattered'). T2 integration shown through finding the core/authentic story in the ruins: 'in the ruins, I found something essential - the actual story I wanted to tell'

paths.description: Moving from elegant constructed narrative to allowing messy authentic truth, finding insight in obscurity
paths.reasoning: Clear M33 path: elegance (constructed narrative) + obscurity (ambiguous moments) → insight ('The insight hit me like lightning'). T2 integration through revelation: 'The revelation was that mystery and complexity ARE the human experience, not obstacles to it'

paths.description: Shifting from theoretical documentation to embodied participation, with camera becoming extension of presence
paths.reasoning: Clear M34 path: insight (about showing vs explaining) + action (going back out filming) → embodiment ('The embodiment of the experience shows'). T2 integration through manifestation: 'You can see the difference between the old disconnected shots and these new living ones'
